schema.propertyKey("since").Int().single().create()
schema.propertyKey("nick").Text().multiple().create()
schema.propertyKey("joined").Timestamp().single().create()
schema.propertyKey("name").Text().single().create()
schema.edgeLabel("knows").multiple().properties("since").create()
schema.vertexLabel("person").properties("name", "nick", "joined").create()
schema.vertexLabel("person").index("search").search().by("name").asString().add()
schema.vertexLabel("person").index("byJoined").materialized().by("joined").add()
schema.vertexLabel("person").index("byName").secondary().by("name").add()
schema.vertexLabel("person").index("knowsBySince").outE("knows").by("since").add()
schema.edgeLabel("knows").connection("person", "person").add()
